madeFor: The goblin rock thrower's throw of Issue-286: the rock flies from the goblin's hand to its target and the grit plays where it lands. The engine has no such ability yet, so `abilities` is empty; Issue-286 names it here when it adds it.

parts.name: projectile
parts.image: rock (PixelLab's own drawing: a thrown rock)

edits: first thrown from [-14, 22] to [22, 22], which are the canvas's coordinates, not the sprite's, so it flew past the ranger; thrown again from the start step with the canvas's own numbers
the debris given a stone ramp and made smaller, 1 to 0.7; its floor scales with its size, so the pieces settled about 7 px above the ground

on the owner's word (2026-11-10) the pieces were brought down to the ground: size 0.7 to 0.88 and the part moved to the centre + (-2, -4), so they settle on the line of the feet; exported again with --replace

files.whole.png: the game pack's whole clip: the effect without the sprite, a sheet of frames
files.manifest.json: the game pack's manifest: the frame size, the sheet's layout, the fps and the offset from the target's feet
files.part-projectile.png: the game pack's projectile clip, 6 frames
files.part-debris_burst.png: the game pack's impact clip, 5 frames

verified: whole.png, part-projectile.png, part-debris_burst.png and manifest.json are byte-identical to the same files in PixelLab's game pack of the effect, downloaded 2026-11-11.
